title: Performance Manipulation: Labor Market Implications in AI-assisted Era
abstract: arXiv:2604.22230v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Performance manipulation arises when agents exploit easily measurable, routine tasks to inflate observable outcomes without contributing genuine innovation or expert judgment. We formalize this phenomenon in a game-theoretic model in which agents allocate effort along two margins. Creative effort is non-routine cognitive labor whose return is complementary to the agent's private expertise; it is the scarce input that principals seek. Mechanistic effort is the execution of well-defined, rule-based tasks that raise performance independently of expertise, a commoditized input that AI heavily augments. We establish the existence of a symmetric, monotone pure-strategy equilibrium and show that performance-based screening remains viable so long as evaluations retain a sufficient creative component, but collapses into an uninformative pooling equilibrium once AI capability grows large enough to crowd out creative effort. translated_title: 绩效操纵：AI辅助时代的劳动力市场影响
translated_abstract: 当代理人利用易于测量、常规性的任务来夸大可观察的绩效结果，而不贡献真正的创新或专家判断时，便产生了绩效操纵。我们在一个博弈论模型中将这一现象形式化，模型中代理人在两个维度上分配努力：创造性努力是非常规的认知劳动，其回报与代理人的私人专业知识互补，是委托人所寻求的稀缺投入；机械性努力则是执行明确定义的、基于规则的任务，这些任务独立于专业知识而提升绩效，是一种被AI大量增强的商品化投入。我们证明了对称、单调纯策略均衡的存在性，并表明只要评估体系中保留足够多的创造性成分，基于绩效的筛选机制仍然可行；但当AI能力增长到足以挤出创造性努力时，该机制将坍缩为无信息量的混同均衡。通过比较……
tldr: 本文构建博弈论模型刻画了AI辅助时代代理人通过机械性努力操纵绩效的现象，证明只要评估保留足够的创造性成分，基于绩效的筛选机制仍可行，但一旦AI能力增强到挤出创造性努力，该机制将坍缩为无信息量的混同均衡。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes performance manipulation in a game-theoretic model where agents split effort between creative and AI-augmented mechanistic tasks, showing that performance-based screening remains viable only when evaluations retain sufficient creative components, but collapses into an uninformative pooling equilibrium once AI capability grows large enough to crowd out creative effort.
